desc: The Dead Air XRF Rimfire Muzzle Brakes offer a streamlined quick-detach mounting system paired with the performance of a single-port brake design, enhancing overall suppressor efficiency. Engineered for the RXD22Ti suppressor is a uniquely tapered rimfire muzzle device, designed for a secure, repeatable lockup across multiple platforms utilizing ½"-28 and M10x1 thread patterns. This system not only simplifies mounting across different firearms but also helps capture lead and debris before it enters the suppressor. The result: improved performance, reduced internal wear, easier maintenance, and extended suppressor service life.
